definitions.description: Indicates an active operational fault condition.

Monitor condition and schedule inspection if warning persists.

definitions.description: Wear parts lifetime reached - replacement or service required.
definitions.action: Perform required maintenance and replace affected components.

definitions.description: Wear parts nearing expected lifetime - replacements or maintenance due soon.
definitions.action: Plan maintenance and prepare replacement parts.

definitions.description: Oil lifetime is close to replacement threshold.

Stop operation and perform oil change immediately.
